notes: The margin's literal glosses (in strength; strengtheneth might) were read and set aside under rule 38; the printed is strong is what is aligned, and it fuses preposition and noun under rules 30 and 40.
The separately segmented article inside that fused expression is excluded from it and marked unrepresented, exactly as rule 30 does for the article of דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים → chronicles.
The competing reading would give is to the preposition alone and mark עֹז unrepresented, which rule 30 forbids where one English word carries both.
